list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM telemetry ORDER BY 1

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM sites ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, type || ' · ' || COALESCE(d.name, LEFT(device_uuid::text, 8)) AS metric FROM telemetry t JOIN devices d ON d.id = t.device_uuid WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND t.type IN ($metric) AND (t.site_id IN ($site) OR t.site_id IS NULL) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Latest value per device and metric

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.device_uuid, t.type) COALESCE(d.name, LEFT(t.device_uuid::text, 8)) AS device, t.type, t.value, t.unit, t.ts FROM telemetry t JOIN devices d ON d.id = t.device_uuid WHERE t.type IN ($metric) AND (t.site_id IN ($site) OR t.site_id IS NULL) ORDER BY t.device_uuid, t.type, t.ts DESC

SELECT a.created_at, COALESCE(r.label, r.metric_type || ' ' || r.op || ' ' || r.threshold) AS alert, a.value, COALESCE(d.name, LEFT(a.device_uuid::text, 8)) AS device, a.delivered FROM alerts a JOIN rules r ON r.id = a.rule_id JOIN devices d ON d.id = a.device_uuid ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 25
